title: Approximation algorithms and ratios for multiple domination in graphs
summary: We analyse approximation algorithms (greedy heuristics) for the classical domination number and two multiple domination numbers in simple graphs. First, we present a short self-contained proof of the known result that the minimum domination problem in any graph $G$ with maximum degree $Δ$ can be solved within the approximation ratio of ${\ln(Δ+1)+1}$. The proof is based on an analysis of a simple greedy heuristic.
